headline: RED / Broad Decline

RHPL (85.54% sell share) and JBLB (86.45% sell share) saw extremely concentrated B58 distribution.

keyInsights.title: Broad Market Decline — 197 Declines vs 64 Advances
keyInsights.body: NEPSE fell -0.48% to 2766.78 with the worst breadth reading of the tracked series — 197 declines vs only 64 advances (3:1 ratio). Every major sector declined except Mutual Fund (+0.32%). Trading Index (-1.71%), Hotels (-1.07%), and Non Life Insurance (-1.21%) led losses. This signals broad institutional and retail selling pressure.

keyInsights.title: B58 Near-Neutral — Selective Buying Despite Red Market
keyInsights.body: Despite the broad decline, B58 was a marginal net buyer (+Rs.5.15M). Key conviction buys: CITY (101,340 kitta, 51.58%), SALICO (14,682 kitta, 53.47%), PRIN (15,990 kitta, 46.46%), NICL (54,400 kitta, 29.30%). Meanwhile, RHPL (85.54% sell) and JBLB (86.45% sell) saw extreme concentrated distribution.
